entries.title: NewCity

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: NewCity is a Steam Early Access city builder with Windows and Linux support. Windows PC is the safest primary route because it is the standard desktop build with the broadest hardware and troubleshooting path, and no Linux-exclusive content is known to exist.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Early Access release on Steam, with the caveat that the developer's last update was over four years ago.

entries.remaster_caveats: NewCity remains in Early Access, and the developer's last update was over four years ago; treat it as playable but unfinished/stale.
